errors.quote: A single lowered reaction rate proves that inhibition is occurring
errors.issue: A lower observed rate can arise from assay interference, enzyme loss or other uncontrolled differences; inhibition is not proved.

errors.quote: which confirms that the calculated 30 nmol/min rate is a valid initial velocity
errors.issue: A linear signal trace alone does not validate its calibration or establish absence of product effects.
Without assay volume, this proposed schedule is unjustified; at an illustrative 1 mL, substantial depletion occurs within seconds.

rationale: Correct arithmetic and broad model identifiability, but overclaims what lower rates and linear traces establish. The initial-rate sampling plan is insufficiently conditioned on available substrate.
